I am a PhD researcher in **Pharmacokinetics and Pharmacodynamics** at Uppsala University,
supervised by Prof. Lena Friberg and Prof. Elin Svensson.

My research focuses on **pharmacometric modelling** to develop antibiotic therapies
via pulmonary delivery, in collaboration with AstraZeneca and Karolinska Institutet.
I build translational PBPK models that bridge preclinical and clinical drug development.

I am passionate about applying **machine learning and AI** to pharmacometrics —
combining mechanistic modelling with data-driven approaches to tackle complex biological problems.

***Based in Uppsala, Sweden. Fluent in English and Mandarin, intermediate Swedish.***

## Education
